description: Objects of PETR_Type are used to request the start of a task in a

attributes.name: jobid
description: Job id of the job to start the task in.

attributes.name: jataskid
description: Array task id of the ja_task to start the pe task in.

attributes.name: queuename
description: Optionally: Name of the queue to start the job in.

attributes.name: cwd
description: Current working directory for the execution of the task.

attributes.name: environment
description: Environment variables to set / to overwrite the job environment with (from qrsh -inherit -v).

attributes.name: submission_time
description: Time when qrsh -inherit was started in microseconds since epoch.

attributes.name: cred
description: Used with the TLS encryption to transport the credentials
from qrsh to the sge_execd, which will store it in the pe_task's active_jobs directory.
